_comment: Host/port are the local Proton Mail Bridge IMAP listener, not Proton's servers.
_comment_mail: How long an unread mail stays on the wall, counted from when it arrived. personMailMinutes is for mail a person wrote. automatedMailMinutes is for mail a machine sent: confirmations, receipts, reminders, codes, invitations, newsletters. Opening a mail takes it down sooner. maxAgeDays is only how far back the unread search looks.
